title: OmniBachi Workflow Schema V0
description: JSON Schema for materialized workflow artifacts. Structural validation only — semantic topology correctness governed by ASSERT_TOPOLOGY_* handlers.

runtime_binding.description: FQDN of the runtime binding artifact (RB_) this act owns — the one that resolves CS implementations for its own records. Exactly one: an act writes what it owns, and ownership that is shared is not ownership.

consults.description: FQDNs of runtime bindings this act reads and never writes — the records another subdomain of this domain owns and this act must consult. Each stays owned and maintained by the subdomain that wrote it; naming one here is a declared reach, not a copy. Absent where an act reads only what it owns, which is most acts.

structure.description: FQDN of the structure artifact that governs this workflow's build configuration

subdomain.description: Subdomain within the workflow's namespace; used for trace and data path routing

requires.description: Events that must have occurred before workflow can execute

forbids.description: Events that must NOT have occurred

bindings.description: Field bindings from admission events to payload

start_node.description: Entry node code (must be an intent node)

nodes.description: Map of node code to node definition

fqdn.description: Authoritative declared identity (namespace::code). Folder location has no authority over identity.

supersedes.description: FQDN of the artifact this one stands in place of. A declared relation between two exact identities, not a resolution rule: references stay exact, and a superseded artifact is unreachable rather than absent.

superseded_by.description: FQDNs of the artifacts that stand in this one's place. Several is the ordinary case — one act split in two retires one artifact and authors two. Its presence means the artifact is superseded: unreachable from the executable projections, retained in the canonical set as history.

emit.description: Event code or emission declaration for this node

next.description: Transition map from result_status to next node
